task: Fix EPMCDME-16530: repository token metrics (input/output/cache tokens) are always zero for codemie-claude sessions in cli-repositories analytics; the real root cause is still unidentified.

key_reasoning.reason: The ticket's two-part root cause (SSO expiry causing a 401 on /v1/analytics/hooks; silent tick skip on stale credentials) was contradicted by the research. The real cause is unidentified. The candidates are hooks absent for codemie-claude, ensureOtlpProxy returning early for a live pid without a health check, and a session-id mismatch against a backend join that lives outside this repo. Acceptance criterion 1 cannot be verified by any repo test, and a repro has to come before the design. This is a discovery-first task with architectural decisions unmade.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity set to XL: stated root cause disproven, fix target unknown, discovery needed first (vague criteria and open design decisions)
